description: This file implements the PrimaryKeyBuilder class and related functions for creating and managing TPM primary keys, including signing and parent keys, within the cuttlefish namespace. It handles key attributes, serialization, and interaction with TPM resources.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating TPM primary keys with specific attributes for signing or parent keys.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder::PrimaryKeyBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the primary key's public area with SHA256 as the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder::SigningKey
methods.description: Configures the builder to create a signing key with specific attributes and HMAC scheme.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder::ParentKey
methods.description: Configures the builder to create a parent key with restricted, decrypt, and fixed TPM attributes.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder::UniqueData
methods.description: Sets the unique data for the key, ensuring it does not exceed the maximum digest size.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder::CreateKey
methods.description: Creates a TPM key using the configured parameters and reserves a slot for it.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder::CreateSigningKey
methods.description: Creates a signing key with specified unique data by invoking the signing key creator function.
